justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/runtime/IRuntime.java and RuntimeJava/Groovy/JavaScript/JRuby/Scala/Kotlin, plus core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jvmlang/LanguageManager.java, core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/AbstractProcess.java, and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/sandbox/Sandbox.java. The package has low fan-in: the only production consumers found are LanguageManager, Sandbox, and AbstractProcess (with one test importing RuntimeJava). Its classes depend outward on process, logger, loader, compiler, and core packages, but the package itself is not a high-fan-in stable package, so there is no evidence of a stable package depending on less stable ones.
